fuzzy.note: tuned on dev rows only for fuzzy_keyword (no LLM); hybrid uses the same cut-off

llm.note: latency = wall clock of the whole claude -p call (process start included)

offline.hybrid: partly: offline for the queries keyword or fuzzy answer (offline_coverage); the rest need the LLM

meta.hybrid_note: hybrid = keyword (whole word + aliases) -> difflib fuzzy alias match (cut-off in thresholds.fuzzy, tuned on dev for fuzzy_keyword) -> LLM only when neither finds a place; LLM answers from the cache only (no new call); latency = local keyword+fuzzy ms, plus the cached wall-clock LLM latency when it falls through
meta.offline_note: embed needs the one-off model download (about 90 MB), then runs without internet

hybrid.offline: partly: offline for the queries keyword or fuzzy answer (offline_coverage); the rest need the LLM
